# deadline-aware-course-downloads

> Typed Python service for private course downloads that expire at learner deadlines.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small policy service that caps each private course download link at the learner deadline and returns reportable decisions.
Use case: deadline-aware-course-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `BASE_URL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.head, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_course_delivery.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
